label: Bible Study
prompt: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All _____ is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
verse: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
note: The lead-in to the Great Commission — all power given, so 'go ye therefore' follows.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and _____, saith the Lord Almighty.
verse: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
note: God promises to be a Father — and makes a point of including both sons and daughters.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Do thy diligence to come before _____. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
verse: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
note: Paul, a prisoner, asks Timothy to hurry and 'come before winter' — perhaps he wanted that cloke.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the God of peace shall _____ Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verse: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
note: An echo of Genesis 3:15 — the serpent's head-crushing promise, now coming 'shortly' under the church's feet.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But Martha was _____ about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
verse: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
note: Martha 'was cumbered about much serving' — weighed down by the busywork — while Mary sat at Jesus' feet.
